text:
**Rowbase is live**

Rowbase launched on March 4, 2026. It turns a CSV file into a live, queryable API, and there's nothing to set up.

Upload a file and Rowbase generates a clean, documented API endpoint that your apps can use right away. It handles five file formats, so most of your existing data should work as it is.

The free tier gives you 1,000 requests per day. That's enough to build, test, and ship without paying anything.

212 beta users helped shape Rowbase, and their feedback went into every feature. Thank you for backing us from the start.

Go to rowbase.dev and drop in your first CSV. We're looking forward to seeing what you build.
